title: Chapter 12: Search
body:
I need to confirm something. I need to confirm my feelings for Alisha. I know that everything went so fast. I was so stupid for not talking to her for a week. She's doing her best to reach me but I pushed her instead.

I need to talk to her.

Lunes, I decided na mag-leave muna sa work dahil mas mahalaga na mapuntahan ko si Alisha. Malamang nasa school sya ngayon, kaya pagkatapos kong magbreakfast eh dumiretso agad ako sa MCHS. At nagmadaling lumakad papunta sa classroom ni Alisha.

Wala sya doon.

Well, maaga pa naman eh. Hindi pa nagi-start ang klase, malamang late lang sya, dahil malayo ang bahay nya.

I've waited and waited, but 9 AM na pero wala parin sya. Nag aalala na ako kaya pumunta ako sa principal's office, at kinausap si Sir Newton.

"Good morning, Sir!" sabi ko.

May halong gulat na sinabi ni Sir Newton "Good morning, Lunes ngayon ah. What brings you here?"

"Eh kasi po, di ba absent ako last Saturday. I just want to apologize. Nakalimutan ko na rin magsabi, kasi something urgent came up."

"Ah, no problem. Since may upcoming event din naman ang school, pinagpractice ko na lang sila ng ipe-perform nila. Pero sana hindi na mauulit yung biglaang pag absent mo ha." sabi ni Sir.

"Noted po." sagot ko. "Ay, Sir, may favor na din po ako --- pwede po bang i-page nyo si Alisha Villegas during lunch, although parang absent sya eh. I just want to make sure."

"Yung girlfriend mo? Bakit? Anong nangyari?" tanong ni Sir.

Tumawa ako at nagsabi "Di naman maiiwasan ang LQ, di ba Sir? Bale pakitext na lang po ako kung nandito na sya. Susubukan ko po syang puntahan sa bahay nila ngayon."

"Ok. Basta ayusin nyo yan ha." sabi ni Sir.

Nagmamadali akong umalis, nakalimutan ko na din magpaalam kay Sir Newton. Malamang nasa bahay lang si Alisha, medyo malayo ang Quezon City, pero maaga pa naman. Sana lang hindi ako ma stuck sa traffic. Tinawagan ko na din si mama na i-text ako if ever na napadaan dun si Alisha. And just to make sure, before ako dumiresto sa bahay ni Alisha, tinawagan ko muna ang ang isang kaibigan.

Nope --- hindi ko pala sya kaibigan, hindi kami close but I know that he's one of the capable persons that could help me. (malapit na ang ending, may bagong character pang ipapakilala?!)

Yes! nagri-ring yung phone nya, buti indi sya busy.

click!

"Hello"

"Bakit ka tumawag, Arthur?"

"Ah, hello Beta! Pwede mo ba akong tulungan? May hinahanap akong tao eh"

"Anong tingin mo sakin? help desk? Eh papunta ka na sa bahay nila, di ba? Bakit sa tingin mo wala sya doon?"

Nagulat ako dahil nahulaan nyang papunta na ako sa bahay ni Alisha kaya di ko mapigilang magtanong "Pano mo nalamang papunta na ako sa kanila?"

"You're window's down, I can hear the gust of the wind. Perhaps you're holding your phone using your left hand, since you are right handed and you're right hand is busy with the steering wheel. Knowing how old your Toyota is, walang bluetooth capability so therefore you can't make a call hands-free. You're in your car right now, driving. So it's only a  question of --- Saan ka kaya pupunta that you'd rather welcome an accident instead of stopping the car muna and call me? The answer lies with your current dilemma. You're looking for someone, malamang una mong pupuntahan ang bahay nya, di ba?"

Amazing talaga itong si Beta...pero may part sakin na ayaw magpatalo kaya sinabi ko "Tama lahat ng sinabi mo except one thing --- hindi bahay nila ang una kong pupuntahan, in fact meron na akong ibang napuntahan --- that is her school."

"Well, kulang ako sa information. Di ko nga alam na babae pala yung hinahanap mo. A student or teacher, perhaps? Kindly fill me in with the details, up to the point kung bakit mo sya hinahanap, then I'll tell you what I think. Just to make it clear, I will not help you in your search operation. I'm busy too."

"Okay. Kahit yung ideas mo lang kung nasaan sya would be a great help. And just as you said, I'm going straight to her home at Quezon City. I'll message you the details later."

"Do it now! Wag mo na ako paghintayin! Itabi mo muna ang kotse mo then text me, baka kasalanan ko pa kapag nabunggo ka." Beta commanded.

"Sige na nga"

I ended the call, and then texted him all the important information that he might need. Yung relationship ko sa kanya, yung current treatment sa kanya sa bahay nila, kung pagiging close ni Alisha sa family ko, even yung pambubully ng classmates nya sa kanya. And kahit yung reason kung bakit humantong lahat sa ganitong sitwasyon, I even told him my speculations regarding the matter.

Then Beta replied right away.

________________________

10-23 9:27 AM

I have a good hunch of where she is, but can you tell me what her last message is. Pati yung exact time.

________________________

________________________

10-23 9:30 AM

halos araw araw sya nagtext sakin. un latest is last Saturday, 5:30 PM...this is her last text:

Sorry. Pero indi mo naman ako dapat iwasan. I think I know why you suddenly changed after our kiss. Im a dirty person, im not perfect, im not pure anymore. sorry kung pinilit kitang maging bf ko. Ako na ang lalayo. Thank you for everything

_______________________

Ngayon ko lang din napagtuunan ng pansin ang mga texts ni Alisha. So I took time para basahin na din isa isa. My tears started to fall. I didn't realize that I've been too discriminating and unfair to her. Ako dapat ang pinakaunang umiintindi sa kanya and yet, ako pa yung unang nagtaboy sa kanya. I'm such an idiot!

Then my phone suddenly vibrates, Beta was calling.

"Hello" sabi ko.

"Go to her home. It's very likely that she's not there but it's better to not leave any stones unturned."

"So nasaan sya sa tingin mo?"

"Nasa bahay nyo. Your mother is in cahoots with Alisha. Tinatago nila si Alisha from you. Di rin naman ako 100% sigurado so it's better to go to her home first."

"Okay. I'll do just that. Salamat Beta, sa uulitin"

"WAG MO ULITIN! MOKONG!" then Beta ended the call.

Medyo gumaan ang loob ko sa sinabi ni Beta, kung ano ano na kasi ang pumasok sa isip ko. She has suicidal tendencies but I also knew how strong she is, and perhaps even Beta concluded na hindi gagawin ni Alisha ang magpakamatay.

So I rushed to Quezon City. Buti na lang talaga kinulit ko dati si Alisha to tell me her home address. 12 noon na nung nakadating ako sa bahay ni Alisha. Ang laki ng bahay! Nakikita ko pa sa bandang likod na may swimming pool pa. Ang daming asong nagsitahulan. Nag doorbell at lumabas ang isang babae, around 30's at medyo astute ang impression that she gives.

"Hello po, dito po ba nakatira si Alisha Villegas?" i said politely.

"Oo. Dito nga, bakit mo sya hinahanap?" Sagot ng babae.

It feels that it's not a question, more like a threat. I have a feeling that I should not disclose everything to this person in front of me.

"Hindi po kasi sya pumasok sa school ngayon. May sakit po ba sya ngayon?"

"Wala sya dito!" mabilis na sagot ng babae.

I need to make sure that she's not hiding Alisha. I need to be able to at least see the inside of house. Malamang sya ang stepmother ni Alisha, and perhaps, sya lang ang tao sa bahay ngayon dahil nag aaral pa din ang mga kapatid ni Alisha. This is the perfect time to use my charisma.

"Ay, hindi pa po pala ako nagpapakilala. Ako po si Arthur, licensed engineer, and currently nagpa-part time job sa school na pinapasukan ni Alisha. Pwede po ba tayong magkwentuhan?"

"Hindi" matipid na sagot nya.

"Ayy, ganun po ba? sayang naman. Ang layo ng biniyahe ko, hindi man lang ako nakapag enjoy. Nagugutom pa naman ako. Mukha pa namang masarap ang ulam nyo ngayon." pabirong sinabi ko.

Of course, mahirap magtiwala sa taong ngayon mo lang nakita. It's impossible for her to trust my words, but I'm gambling with her loneliness. She might just bite if I offer her my presence.

I combed my hair using my hands. Pa cool effect, kahit ang init dito sa labas. Malay natin tumalab sa kanya ang charms ko.

"Come inside, let's have some fun" sabi ng babae.

Kitams! Nagwork! Makakalibre pa nga ng tanghalian. 2 birds in 1 stone.

But the sad thing is, mukhang wala talaga si Alisha sa loob. Mag isa lang ang stepmother nya ngayon sa bahay. Now I have to spend an hour or two just to be polite.

What the hell am I doing here?!

Moral lesson: Don't make your moves to lonely moms.
